snapshot.text: Fragmented system with five subsystems: the Ministry of Health (Minsa) covers about 60% of people, EsSalud about 30%, and the armed forces, police and private sector the rest. President Keiko Fujimori's government took office on 28 July 2026, after several health ministers in quick succession.

priorities.title: Four axes
priorities.text: The new minister's lines are fighting anaemia, cutting waiting times, free-market measures and preparing for El Niño.

priorities.title: Primary care and digital health
priorities.text: Minsa prioritises first-level facilities to relieve hospitals; by November 2026 it had connected 743,000 clinical records and added 300 facilities to telehealth.

priorities.title: El Niño preparedness
priorities.text: The ministry approved an operational plan for El Niño 2026-2027 and works with the US embassy on prevention.

netherlands.text: The Netherlands and Peru jointly led adoption of the 2024 World Health Assembly resolution on climate change and health. I found no bilateral health programme in my searches.

timeline.text: Juan Carlos Velasco replaces Luis Quiroz as health minister.
Peru joins PAHO's Alliance for Primary Health Care in the Americas.
Keiko Fujimori takes office; Luis Dyer sworn in as health minister.
Operational plan for El Niño 2026-2027 approved.
743,000 clinical records connected and 300 facilities added to telehealth.
